title: Suwon K-drama filming locations: 8 spots to visit
desc: K-drama filming locations around Suwon, centred on Hwaseong Fortress and Haenggung-dong; an easy day trip from Seoul.

items.title: Hwahongmun Gate (Buksumun)
items.memo: Fortress gate seen in Lovely Runner; best around sunset.

items.title: Banghwasuryujeong Pavilion
items.memo: Pavilion linked to Twenty-Five Twenty-One; great city views from the walls.

items.title: Mong Ted Cafe (Im Sol's House)
items.memo: Cafe used as Im Sol's house in Lovely Runner; try the coffee and salt bread.

items.title: Kazaguruma (카자구루마)
items.memo: Exterior of the gimbap shop in Extraordinary Attorney Woo; serves katsu.

items.title: Haenggung-dong
items.memo: Neighbourhood used in several dramas; murals and indie cafes.

items.title: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress
items.memo: UNESCO-listed fortress linked to Twenty-Five Twenty-One; walk the wall.

items.title: Wolhwawon Garden (월화원)
items.memo: Chinese-style garden seen in Moon Lovers: Scarlet Heart Ryeo.

items.title: Suwon Irwol Arboretum
items.memo: Arboretum fans link to Queen of Tears (unconfirmed); greenhouse walks.
